desc: Derive and prove the exact formula for the minimum stair count given the maximum level at which the two queried blocks are connected.
Design the descending-height DSU construction and determine how to represent component merge levels in a reconstruction tree.
Implement LCA preprocessing on the reconstruction tree, including same-block queries and connectivity at floor 1.
Verify complexity and memory bounds for up to \(250{,}000\) cells and \(200{,}000\) queries in Python.
Prepare robust stdin/stdout implementation details, including iterative preprocessing and binary-lifting tables.
